Single trigger inside a Tabs list that selects which panel of content is shown. isActive marks the selected tab; exactly one tab is active per list. Available in the pill variant (selected tab is a raised chip on a recessed track). Disabled tabs are not selectable and appear in the default state only. In code, focus is implemented without a nested FocusRing component.
